Liam: Draft landing page brief: 1-line hook, 3 learning bullets, 1 CTA. I'll post by Tue EOD.
Priya: Email cadence: Day0 thanks+runbook, Day3 short demo clip, Day9 benchmarks+invite to eval.
Noor: eng-runtime please confirm test pool Monday 09:00-12:00 PT with KV=true and fallback model tag. Local command: `./provision_demo.sh --env=test --kv=true --small-model=true`
eng-runtime: Can provision a 3-hour test pool. Ping exact tag and window.
ops-bot: Calendar invites created: "Webinar rehearsal" Tue May 21 09:30 PDT and "Greenroom" Wed May 22 09:45 PDT. :calendar:
